items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: He played on the boat with Tony Catalano. He was the piano player with Tony Catalano at one time

ctx.x: Carlisle Evans, yes, he was out of Davenport, Iowa. He played on the boat with Tony Catalano. He was the piano player with Tony Catalano at one time, and he succeeded, uh, Stacy, I believe, Carlisle Evans. They wanted to have a band of his own for a few years.
Fred Fleck was the name of the band. I'm not sure. I don't remember his name.
